description: Open-sourced membership-ops playbook as an Agent Skill: a complete, copyable chain-store membership data platform showroom (54 datasets / 25 ETLs / 12 dashboards in DIM/DWD/DWS/ADS/DQC layers, fully simulated data — 80k members, 1,200 stores, 1.29M orders) + a restaurant BI formula playbook (9 volumes, ~2,900 lines: repurchase calibers, RFM 8-segment strategies, coupon redemption, retention/churn, field dictionary, NULL tri-state traps, DWD wide-table paradigms, 39 production-ETL catalog) + an award-winning live-talk methodology transcript (5-step action chain, trust quartet, 'AI that knows when to shut up'). Eight consulting jobs: caliber & formula Q&A, membership data architecture design from zero (staged DIM→DWD→DWS→ADS minimal sets), gap diagnosis against the 54-dataset checklist, DDL generation, role-based dashboard planning, data-quality troubleshooting, methodology teaching, and full replication onto Guandata BI. Platform-agnostic (SQL in Spark 3.4 dialect); all values are simulated — only structures and calibers are citable. Guandata platform operations belong to the sibling skill majia-guanyuan.
